messages:
rachel: quick follow-up on postmortem for the repeated latency/throughput flares on infer-cluster. want owners for remediation, short SLO guardrail, and dashboards for recurrence patterns.

tom: I see 4 events in last 14 days tied to long sequences + large batch merges. dashboard link: https://dash.redwood.internal/d/recurrence (99p focus).

priya: Suggest we add an operational SLO for 30d: 'critical-cust 99p latency <400ms'. leave public SLA unchanged. Also add alert at 7d error-budget 70% and 90%.

dave: I'll implement per-model and per-tenant 99p panels and a projected-burn line. ETA 24h for panels.

alertbot: Incident 2026-03-21: label recurring-latency-bursts, linked PM-5201.

priya: I'll run a canary increasing KV cache by 25% on node-pool C and capture eviction traces. ETA 48h.

tom: infra reports brief disk latency spikes on some nodes during heavy batching. I will correlate node IDs and suggest cordon/evict thresholds. ETA 12h.

rachel: Owners and timeline: dashboards (dave) 24h, canary+traces (priya) 48h, node correlation (tom) 12h, ops note for support (rachel) COB. Review sync Tue 10am PT.

dave: adding a synthetic test to validate 95/99/99.9 and a probe query: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(request_latency_bucket{env="prod"}[5m])) by (le,model)).

priya: if canary reduces 99p by <12% we rollback config. otherwise propose short-term throttles for seq>2048 on non-critical tenants.

rachel: I'll post these actions to the postmortem tracker and ping owners on deliverables board. update thread with blockers. :thumbsup:
